text:
alex: Heads-up — we need a short security/privacy/compliance sync next week to prep for the audit and finalize threat model + access review. Can folks fill availability? Proposed slots: Tue 2:00pm-2:45pm or Wed 11:00am-11:45am PT.

priya: Prefer Tue 2pm if possible. I have a docs walkthrough to give for the onboarding flow threat model.

jordan: Wed 11 won't work for me (customer calls). Tue 2 looks good. Please add IAM/access review to agenda.

sam: I can lead the threat model review for onboarding flow. I'll bring the dataflow diagram and STRIDE notes.

maria: SGTG for Tue 2. Can we add a checklist for audit artifacts (logs, retention, KMS proof)? I'll put a draft in the doc.

alex: Great — agenda draft below. Add items or owners.

```
1) Quick status (5m) — alex
2) Threat model: onboarding flow (20m) — sam (diagram + STRIDE)
3) Access & IAM review (10m) — jordan
4) Audit artifacts checklist & gaps (5m) — maria
5) Action items & owners (5m)
```

lee: Can we also cover service-account rotation and key-storage locations? Might be 3-4m on the artifacts section.

priya: I'll attach the onboarding sequence screenshots and a short pre-read in the doc. folks: please review before the meeting.

maria: Pre-read link: https://redwood-internal/docs/security/onboarding-threat-model (please leave inline comments).

alex: Poll results so far: Tue 2 — alex, priya, jordan, sam, maria, lee = majority. I'll send calendar invite for Tue 2:00pm PT and mark as "security/audit prep".

security-bot: Calendar event created: "Security Audit Prep — Threat Model + Access Review" Tue Jul 30 14:00 PT (Zoom link added). Invitees: alex, priya, jordan, sam, maria, lee.

jordan: One ask — add a short slide for historical incidents that impacted onboarding auth (2 slides max). I'll prepare.

sam: Also: can infra provide recent access logs for the onboarding service? @lee can you pull 30 days of auth logs and drop in the doc?

lee: Yup — pulling logs now, will upload to the doc by EOD Monday.

maria: If anyone has outstanding compliance questions to escalate to AuditOps, drop them here and I'll summarize.

alex: Action items so far: sam (threat model + diagram), jordan (incidents slides + IAM notes), maria (artifact checklist + doc collate), lee (auth logs), priya (pre-read screenshots). I'll create the agenda card in Asana and link it in the invite.

priya: also request: please mute camera if joining from public place :slightly_smiling_face:

alex: Thanks — see you Tue 2pm PT. If you can't make it, leave notes in the doc and we'll triage async.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: adding a quick table of required artifacts to the doc now.

security-bot: Reminder set for 30 minutes before event.

alex: (closing) If anything else to add to agenda, drop it before Monday 5pm PT so we can finalize the deck.
